title: How to Repair MS Office (Official Dell Tech Support)
description: Learn how to repair MS Office app when a MS Office program/application isn't working properly, such as Word or Excel. Follow these steps when restarting them doesn't fix the problem. LINK: Office 365 or 2019 https://support.office.com/article/4414eaaf-0478-48be-9c42-23adc4716658?wt.mc_id=SCL_DemsToken_262f265f-4c5e-4c46-852f-2a3890829d34 LINK: Office 2013 or 2016 https://support.office.com/article/7c695b06-6d1a-4917-809c-98ce43f86479?wt.mc_id=SCL_DemsToken_262f265f-4c5e-4c46-852f-2a3890829d34 If you have questions or need support, contact us through social media on Facebook at www.facebook.com/dell and Twitter at www.twitter.com/dellcares  You can also join in a chat on our Dell Community Forum at www.dell.com/community and click on Support Forums. To learn more about our Dell Community Forum check out http://dell.to/2tbhVvt For additional guidance with your PC's maintenance and troubleshooting visit http://dell.to/2te92S1

asr.full_text: If a Microsoft Office program or application isn't working properly, such as Word or Excel, here's what you can do when restarting them doesn't fix the problem Repair Office from the Control Panel Right click on the Start button and select Apps & Features Select the Microsoft Office product that you want to repair and then select Modify And follow the steps Use the Easy-Fix tool to completely uninstall Microsoft Office. Click on the link for the tool download which is provided in the description to uninstall Office. When ready, run the Easy Fix tool. The wizard for the uninstallation process will launch so just select next and follow the prompts. After the uninstallation successful screen appears restart your computer for the changes to take effect and then reinstall Office. To reinstall Microsoft Office look in the video description for the link of the version you want to install. Remember whenever you need help or have questions you can always reach out to us through social media on Facebook or Twitter or join in a chat on the Dell Community Forum. Be sure to check out our other videos on this channel and if you liked this video give it a LIKE and don't forget to SUBSCRIBE. Thanks for watching!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is to provide Microsoft Office troubleshooting instructions, including repair, removal, restart, and reinstallation steps for Word or Excel problems. The Windows screens showing Office in Apps & features and an Office uninstall troubleshooter are consistent with that instructional purpose, while the requests to like or subscribe are ordinary audience engagement and are not connected to payment, investment, credential collection, or another financial offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational technology tutorial demonstrating Microsoft Office repair, uninstallation, restart, and reinstallation procedures.
